# System prompts for Claude Projects

Longer system prompts that set up a Claude Project or a custom assistant for an ongoing job.

Fill in the `[BRACKETS]` and paste a prompt into any assistant, with [about-me.md](../about-me.md) above it, or ask Claude to use it by name through the `prompt-library` skill.

| Prompt | Use when |
|---|---|
| [Visual inspiration assistant](visual-inspiration-assistant.md) | setting up a Claude Project that captures, tags and searches design inspiration |

*This file is generated by `scripts/build.py` from the prompts' frontmatter.*
